|translation='''Title:''' Death Star Gunner (gunner).

'''Card text:'''
If on the Death Star, adds 2 to the total of Commence Primary Ignition (cumulative). During your control phase, you may send this gunner to the Used Pile and search the Reserve Deck for Superlaser and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace.

'''Lore:'''
Many Imperial gunners dreamed of being TIE pilots but lacked the skill to fly. Some were assigned to the Death Star and given the main gun.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title includes （砲手）. Japanese does not OR the Superlaser search.
